title: React.js Conf 2016 - Ben Alpert - What Lies Ahead
summary: Ben Alpert of the React team talks at React.js Conf 2016 about where React is heading. He covers performance and stability work, challenges at Facebook, and opportunities such as bringing React Native ideas to the web.
why: HN points to it as a primary source for what the React team was actually working on, such as React Native for the web.

quote.text: They are specifically working on it according to this React.js Conf talk [0].
